about.en: UnitedHealth xStock (UNHx) is a tracker certificate on UnitedHealth Group shares issued by Backed under the xStocks brand and offered to non-US investors. Each token is backed 1:1 by UNH shares held with custodians and tracks the share price on-chain; it is a claim on the issuer, not direct ownership of the shares. It is deployed on Solana (XszvaiXGPwvk2nwb3o9C1CX4K6zH8sez11E6uyup6fe) and at 0x167a6375dA1efc4a5bE0f470e73ECEFd66245048 on Ethereum, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, Mantle and other EVM chains.
